pageDescription: Structured vulnerability reports and technical documentation from authorized testing.

items.label: Vulnerability Report
items.title: Brute-Force Vulnerability — Missing Rate Limiting
items.description: Authentication endpoint with no rate limiting, allowing unlimited login attempts. Identified during authorized internship testing.

items.label: Vulnerability Report
items.title: Improper Server-Side Input Validation
items.description: Missing server-side validation on user_type field accepted arbitrary values through direct API requests, affecting data integrity.

items.title: The Night My Network Finally Lit Up
items.description: A real-world engineering story about troubleshooting a CCTV system that revealed deeper networking concepts including PoE power issues, IP conflicts, CGNAT limitations, IPv6 connectivity, DDNS automation, and building a small Android tool to solve remote access challenges.

items.label: Vulnerability Report
items.title: IDOR in Faculty Verification SSE Endpoint
items.description: Unauthorized access to faculty verification data via IDOR. Manipulating userId exposed sensitive user information without proper authorization checks.
